rules.title: How to play
rules.who: This is Findo. She is hiding on every map.
rules.find.body: She is drawn like everyone else around her. Look for the brown braids, the yellow top and the violet skirt.
rules.move: Drag to move, pinch to zoom
rules.move.body: The maps are far bigger than the screen. On the later levels you will not find her without zooming in.
rules.wrong.body: Tapping the wrong person takes 15 points and 3 seconds off the clock.
rules.fast: The faster you find her, the better
rules.fast.body: Every second left on the clock is worth 10 points, and your total decides one to three stars.
rules.hint.body: A hint moves the map towards Findo and makes her glow. You start with three. Every 10 stars you collect earn another one free.
sheet.title: Look for her
chapter.1.name: Curious
chapter.1.blurb: Ten crowds behind you. You know her three marks by heart now -- brown braids, a yellow top with a black yoke, a violet skirt -- and from here on she stops making it easy.
chapter.2.name: Observer
chapter.2.blurb: She shrinks every level until she reaches a size she will never go below. And here come the first who look like her: two on every map, each wearing one of her marks.
chapter.3.name: Sentinel
chapter.3.blurb: The scenes start to move. Snow, bubbles, confetti. Everything that drifts pulls the eye -- and she is the only thing standing still.
chapter.4.name: Braid Hunter
chapter.4.blurb: You have stopped sweeping at random. Six impostors on every map, and some now carry two of her three marks. Hunting for yellow alone gets you caught here.
chapter.5.name: Crowd Reader
chapter.5.blurb: A crowd is not noise, it is structure. You know where people stand and where they only pass through, and she will not be there. Eight impostors, six hundred people.
chapter.6.name: Detective
chapter.6.blurb: Ten impostors, two of them sharing two marks out of three. They no longer fool you: you check the third before your finger comes down.
chapter.7.name: Quick Eye
chapter.7.blurb: Time is all that is left. She will not shrink further and the maps will not fill further -- only the clock tightens, and the time bonus is most of the score.
chapter.8.name: Hawk
chapter.8.blurb: Your hand is ahead of your reasoning. You tap before you have finished working out why, and you are right. Fourteen impostors among nine hundred people.
chapter.9.name: Marksman
chapter.9.blurb: She is not hiding from you any more, she is only buying seconds. The hiding place changes every attempt, and you reach all of them -- without one wasted tap.
chapter.10.name: All-Seeing
chapter.10.blurb: Forty-five seconds. Nine hundred people. Eighteen impostors, four of them nearly her. And the air is full of movement.
